items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Because, I know Joe Lovano’s father, he talks about him.

ctx.x: We came up on—maybe it wasn’t this one—I want to say Carter? No…Joe. Because, I know Joe Lovano’s father, he talks about him. He was the cat.

He was the cat. He was a big guy. He looked like George Colon. I can’t think of his name. Then there was another guy they called Popeye. He had another name. He did some dates around with some good people. He was still lingering with the other stuff.
